info.desc: Nightclubbing is the fifth studio album by Grace Jones, released in 1981. It is the second of three post-disco albums that Jones made at Compass Point Studios in the Bahamas and became Jones' commercial breakthrough and also formed the basis of her groundbreaking concept tour A One Man Show. It claimed the number one slot on NME Album of the Year. The lead-off single for the album was "Demolition Man" written by Sting for Jones and also included on The Police's album Ghost in the Machine later in the year. podcast.title: Post-Disco Reinvention
podcast.body: This album is regarded as possibly the most passionate and significant work of Grace Jones's career. Emerging after the anti-disco riots, it marked a profound reinvention of her sound, shifting from her disco roots to an entirely new electronic style. This new direction was heavily influenced by African rhythms and Jamaican sounds, signifying the beginning of what would become the greatest stage of her artistic journey. "tenemos posiblemente la hora más apasionante que tenemos a carrera de grisos que es el Nightclubbing cuando ella todavía conocida como el gran icono de la música disco y de la música disco gay que era se reinventa con una nueva manera totalmente electrónica influenciada por ritmos africanos influenciada por sonidos a jamaycanos y nación a nueva grisos que sería la etapa más grande de su carrera."
